name: Cliff Goat
notes: DRAFT for C13-2 (bestiary-plan.md). Lowers its horns and charges in a straight line. Stats are TODO for the Researcher (R-BAL-8). Distances in tiles, times in ticks (20 per second).
tell: stamps, then long red circle at the line's end
senseiLine: It stamps before it charges. Get ready.
description: Lowers its horns and charges in a straight line.

bestiary.tip: Step aside, or COUNTER at the end.

lore.green: This goat once skipped happily up the cliffs. Calm it, and it bounds back to the high rocks.
